# Purifying Peel-Off Blackhead Mask with Activated Charcoal

Give your pores a deep-cleansing refresh with this charcoal peel-off face mask. It's formulated to help lift blackheads, excess oil, and stubborn surface dirt, leaving your skin looking clearer and feeling fresher.

## Key Features
- Activated charcoal black formula for full-face or targeted use
- Suitable for all skin types
- Rosemary and calendula extracts
- Easy to apply two to three times a week

## Benefits for Your Skin Routine
Spread the mask over your nose, chin, forehead, or entire face. As it dries, it helps lift debris from pores, so peeling it away leaves your skin feeling smooth and clean. Rosemary extract supports a healthy oil balance, while calendula helps keep skin comfortable and soft. Follow with your usual moisturizer to help lock in hydration.

## How to Use
Apply to dry, cleansed skin, avoiding the eyes, lips, and brows. Wait 15 to 30 minutes until fully dry, then peel gently from the bottom up. If you have dry skin, apply a moisturizing toner or lotion first.

## Add It to Your Weekly Routine
Ready for a clearer-looking complexion? Add this peel-off mask to your weekly routine and enjoy a fresh, deep-cleansed feel. Order yours today.
